title: The /v1/charges endpoint is deprecated and will be removed
body: The legacy /v1/charges API is deprecated. Requests to /v1/charges will return HTTP 410 after March 1, 2027. You must migrate to /v1/payment_intents, which supports the same flows plus SCA. Accounts pinned to API version 2024-06-20 or earlier are affected. See the migration guide for a field-by-field mapping. This is a breaking change; no automatic translation is applied.

title: Improved search filters in the Dashboard
body: You can now filter payments by metadata key in the Dashboard. No action is required and the API is unchanged.

title: Shutting down text-embedding-ada-002
body: text-embedding-ada-002 is deprecated. The model will be shut down on January 15, 2027 and requests will fail after that date. Migrate to text-embedding-3-small, which is cheaper and higher quality. Embeddings are not compatible across models, so vectors must be regenerated before you switch.

title: gpt-4-turbo retirement schedule published
body: gpt-4-turbo will be retired on 2027-06-01. Requests specifying that model after the retirement date will return a 404 model_not_found error. We recommend moving to the current flagship model. No action required before then, but pinned model strings must be updated.

title: Node.js 18 is past end of life on 2025-04-30
body: Node.js release cycle 18. End of life: 2025-04-30. This version no longer receives security updates. Upgrade is required. Container images and CI runners still pinned to node 18 will not receive patches for future CVEs.

title: Actions runners drop Node 16; update actions/checkout@v3
body: Workflows using actions that run on the Node 16 runtime will stop working on 2026-12-01. actions/checkout@v3 and actions/setup-node@v3 are affected and are deprecated; upgrade to @v4 or later. After the date, affected steps will fail with an unsupported runtime error. Action required by all repositories that pin v3.

title: Stricter rate limits for chat.postMessage on non-Marketplace apps
body: Beginning on November 3, 2026, chat.postMessage will be limited to one message per channel per second for apps not listed in the Slack Marketplace. Bursts will receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Applications that fan out notifications must add queuing before this date.

title: Programmable Messaging price update for US long code
body: Effective on January 5, 2027, per-message pricing for US long code SMS increases by $0.0015 per segment. Carrier pass-through fees are unchanged. Existing volume commitments are honoured through their term.

title: supabase-js v3 released with breaking changes
body: BREAKING: supabase-js v3 removes the deprecated .from().select() overload that accepted a count option as the second argument, and drops support for Node 18. createClient now requires an explicit auth configuration object. See the migration guide before upgrading.

title: PostgreSQL 14 reaches end of life on 2026-11-12
body: PostgreSQL release cycle 14. End of life: 2026-11-12. Plan the upgrade before this date; after it there are no security fixes. Managed providers will begin forced upgrades in the weeks following.

title: Alpine 3.18 base images move to unsupported
body: Images based on Alpine 3.18 stop receiving security updates after 2026-11-01. Rebuild against a supported base tag. Images that pin node:18-alpine inherit this and should be rebuilt on a maintained tag.

title: New app icon guidelines
body: We refreshed the guidance for app icons in the Marketplace listing. Nothing changes for you and no action is required.
